description:
This endpoint updates the predefined variations for a Feature Flag or Setting identified by the `settingId` parameter.
**Important:** You can only update a predefined variation's value if it is not used anywhere in your feature flags.

hint.description: The name of the Predefined Variation, shown on the Dashboard UI. If not set, the Value will be shown.

name.description: The name of the Predefined Variation, shown on the Dashboard UI. If not set, the Value will be shown.

predefinedVariationId.description: The Predefined Variation's identifier to update. Omit the value if you want to add a new predefined variation.

value.description: Represents the value of a Predefined Variation.

boolValue.description: The served value in case of a boolean Feature Flag.

doubleValue.description: The served value in case of a decimal number Setting.

intValue.description: The served value in case of a whole number Setting.

stringValue.description: The served value in case of a text Setting.

name: update-predefined-variations
